name: ks-telegram
description: Modern Telegram integration toolkit for WordPress and WooCommerce.

scripts.build: npm run build:scss && npm run build:js && npm run i18n
scripts.build:assets: npm run build:scss && npm run build:js
scripts.i18n:merge: msgmerge --update --backup=off languages/ks-telegram-ru_RU.po languages/ks-telegram.pot && msgmerge --update --backup=off languages/ks-telegram-uk_UA.po languages/ks-telegram.pot
scripts.i18n:compile: msgfmt languages/ks-telegram-ru_RU.po -o languages/ks-telegram-ru_RU.mo && msgfmt languages/ks-telegram-uk_UA.po -o languages/ks-telegram-uk_UA.mo && msgfmt languages/ks-telegram-uk_UA.po -o languages/ks-telegram-uk.mo
scripts.i18n: npm run i18n:pot && npm run i18n:merge && npm run i18n:compile
scripts.lint: npm run lint:js && npm run lint:scss
